page.layout: One printed page: title page. Centred title block at top; below it a woodcut coat of arms (a bear rampant on a diagonal-banded shield, no text); below that the imprint in centred lines. A handwritten shelf mark at lower centre is not transcribed.

main_text.l: THEOLOGI, LECTIONES SEPTEM de Cœna Domini ex variis Scripturæ locis sumptæ,
Excudebat Ioannes le Preux Illustriss. D. Bern. Typograph.

page.notes: Woodcut of a bear rampant on a shield with diagonal bands, between the title and the imprint. The handwritten "Se 4382" at the lower centre is a shelf mark and is left out. Title lines are set in spaced capitals and italics as printed; "SE-ptem" and "Scri-pturæ" are line-end hyphenations, and "INDI-cabit" is printed with a hyphen at the line end.
